# CS-001 Key-Account Service Levels

## 1. Purpose

### 1.1 Objective
This document sets the service levels Meridian Supply Co. commits to for its most important customers so that warehouse, transport and customer service teams work to the same targets.

### 1.2 Scope
It applies to orders, shipments, damage claims and returns for Tier-1 accounts.

## 2. Tier-1 Accounts

### 2.1 Current Tier-1 list
The Tier-1 accounts are:

- Harbor Point Grocers
- Cascade Medical Supply

The list is reviewed each January by the Customer Service Manager and the Director of Operations. Other accounts are served under the standard terms.

## 3. Order and Shipping Service Levels

### 3.1 Order cut-off for same-day shipping
Orders received by 3 pm local time on a working day ship the same day. Orders received after 3 pm ship the next working day. The cut-off is applied by order-entry timestamp and is shown on the customer portal.

### 3.2 Fill-rate target
The fill-rate target for Tier-1 accounts is 98%. Fill rate is the share of ordered units shipped complete on the first shipment. It is measured weekly per account and reported on the operations dashboard.

### 3.3 Shortfall actions
When projected fill rate for an account falls below target, Customer Service contacts the customer, Procurement expedites open POs for the affected items and the Warehouse Supervisor prioritises picking.

## 4. Damage and Returns Service Levels

### 4.1 Damage claims acknowledged within 4 business hours
A damage claim from a Tier-1 account is acknowledged within 4 business hours of receipt. The acknowledgement gives a case number and the next step. Photographs are requested if not supplied.

### 4.2 RMA credit issued within 5 days
For an approved return, credit is issued within 5 days of the return being inspected and graded under WH-004. Credit is net of any restocking fee that applies under WH-004.

### 4.3 Summary of service levels

| Measure | Target |
|---|---|
| Same-day shipping cut-off | 3 pm |
| Fill rate | 98% |
| Damage claim acknowledgement | 4 business hours |
| RMA credit | 5 days |

## 5. Governance

### 5.1 Reporting
Customer Service publishes the monthly service report for each Tier-1 account, showing fill rate, claims and credits.

### 5.2 Explaining misses
Misses are explained in the report with the cause and the corrective action.

### 5.3 Customer communication
Each Tier-1 account has a named service contact. The contact tells the customer about any delay to a shipment as soon as it is known, not on the day it was due. Customers receive a shipping notice with tracking details on the day the order leaves the building.

### 5.4 Review of the service levels
The targets in this document are reviewed annually. Temporary relief for peak periods is recorded in the service report so that the effect on fill rate can be explained.

### 5.5 Training
New customer service staff and dock supervisors are briefed on these service levels during induction. The briefing covers the cut-off time, the claim acknowledgement standard and the credit timing, and how to find the current account list.
